content.short: LiquidSwap is a DEX aggregator serving HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain with intelligent routing.
content.description: LiquidSwap routes swaps across the liquidity available on HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain, splitting an order between venues where that improves the rate. It aggregates 33 venues and 21 oracle-validated pools, and reads Hyperliquid precompiles directly so spreads tighten against raw prices instead of pool drift. Alongside the aggregator it runs a pAMM liquidity layer and the LiquidLaunch token launchpad, with an API reference for integrators. It is distinct from the Aptos exchange of the same name.
